maddeler.e:
نرتجف (form VIII)
# نَرْتَجِفُ (nartajifu) /nar.ta.d͡ʒi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# نَرْتَجِفَ (nartajifa) /nar.ta.d͡ʒi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# نَرْتَجِفْ (nartajif) /nar.ta.d͡ʒif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
